Subject: Post-demo model runbook + prioritized recommendations (next steps)

Emma / Rajiv — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. I promised a concise recap and a recommendation on the shortlist + next steps to validate fit. Below is a runnable "model runbook" we can use to drive the evals and a prioritized recommendation with rationale.

Summary (quick):
- Primary goal: Replace FinLytics' existing summarization + insight extraction microservice with an inference-backed pipeline that meets 400ms median latency (per request), <=8% token-cost uplift budget, and maintain equal-or-better extractive accuracy on the 12 curated prompt tests you shared.
- Key constraints: 6k average context (most calls include recent transcript + 2–3 docs), strict PII redaction, and SLA requirements for <200ms p95 for priority endpoints.

Prioritized shortlist (why these 3):
1) redwood-instruct-7b-q4f16 (Recommended pilot)
   - Rationale: Strong instruction-following at low cost; quantized path hits ~0.7x latency vs larger models and gives best cost/accuracy tradeoff for shorter outputs. Good for extractive + structured outputs.
   - Observed local benchmark (see attachment): median latency ~160ms / token on G4-equivalent, 1.2M tokens = ~$6.8 (unit extrapolated).

2) rw-llama3-13b-q8 (Balanced ops)
   - Rationale: Better long-context coherence and fewer truncation artifacts at 6k+ contexts, higher quality on summarization. Cost ~2.8x redwood-instruct-7b; p95 latency is ~320ms without batching. Use for higher-value batch jobs or canary for critical customers.

3) gptj-30b-int8 (High-quality fallback)
   - Rationale: Highest extractive recall on your testset; however cost and latency are significant. Use as a degradation fallback for complex documents (run only when quality score below threshold).

Quality/regression concerns to watch during evals:
- Prompt sensitivity: some of your "insight extraction" prompts produce high variance on smaller models when the docs include developer notes (we flagged 3 prompts). We included a cleaned prompt_set_finlytics_v2.txt attachment and recommended control examples.
- Hallucination on entity linking: for contextual asks that require exact stakeholder names, run the model + retrieval pipeline and score against the canonical entity list.
- Truncation vs. chunking: Llama3-13b will perform better if we switch to 8k context or streaming KV cache. If staying at 6k, expect ~6% regression on multi-doc summarization.

Suggested evaluation plan (72–96 hour run):
- Day 0–1: Smoke tests — run the 120 prompt set (attached) against all three models on a representative sample (10k requests). Provide token-level cost and latency per route.
- Day 1–2: Stress & p95 profiling — run mixed-batch loads, measure p50/p95/p99, identify tail latencies and memory pressure.
- Day 3–4: Quality A/B — run 1:1 A/B on 5k requests vs baseline, capture extractive recall/F1 and human pass/fail.

Immediate asks from you:
- Can you confirm who on your side will provide the canonical entity list and the 10k representative requests?
- Any blackout windows this week for a short 45–60m follow-up?

Attachments: finlytics_benchmarks_v1.csv (model-by-model token/time), prompt_set_finlytics_v2.txt, ma_table-pricing-estimates.xlsx

I'll follow up with a HubSpot update and share the Drive folder with the raw logs. If agreeable, we can spin up a 72-hour pilot on Redwood Hosted and toggle routing to Dedicated if we hit tail issues.

— Soojin

Emma — quick note on the p95 question. On Hosted, redwood-instruct-7b-q4f16 consistently hits ~180–210ms p95 for single-request median config when the model isn't under cross-tenant memory pressure. Two operational levers to meet 200ms p95 reliably:
- Option A (fast): dedicate a small pool (2–4 GPUs) for the realtime route on Dedicated for a 10–15% capacity premium.
- Option B (control-plane): enable aggressive prefix caching + smaller dynamic batching windows (adds complexity but may keep Hosted within budget).

If you'd like, Priyom and I can run a short hosted pilot with a synthetic spike to demonstrate the p95 tail within 24 hours. That will show which operational approach is simplest for you.

Marissa
